hooks.name: branchyard-session-start
hooks.command: command -v by >/dev/null 2>&1 && by hook --harness qwen-code session-start || true

hooks.name: branchyard-user-prompt-submit
hooks.command: command -v by >/dev/null 2>&1 && by hook --harness qwen-code user-prompt-submit || true

statusLine.command: command -v by >/dev/null 2>&1 && by statusline --harness qwen-code || true
